messages.攻撃スキルの挑発値で敵の攻撃を引き寄せ、スキルレベルの高い回避「ルトレット」でか: An evade tank that draws attacks through Aggro on her attack skills, then repeatedly avoids them with the high-skill-level Retraite. S2 Punition is her main attack.
messages.守備「ルトレット」: スキルレベル人格Lv+5、マッチ威力5~15。自分の速度が: **Defense skill — Retraite**: Skill Level Identity Lv +5, Clash Power 5–15. The faster she is than the attacker, the higher its Coin Power, +1 per point of Speed difference (up to 3; +1 if faster at lower Uptie). Grants 1 Poise on a successful Evade (up to 10, 5 at lower Uptie).
messages.挑発値とクイック: S1「マルシュ」は使用時に次のターンのクイック2と挑発値3(: **Aggro and Haste**: S1 Marche grants 2 Haste and 3 Aggro next turn on use (1 at lower Uptie). S2 also grants 4 Aggro next turn on use (2 at lower Uptie).
messages.バトルパッシブ「いなす」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 回避成功時、次のタ: **Combat passive — Redirect (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On a successful Evade, gains 1 Haste next turn and pushes her own Stagger Threshold back by 5 (up to 3 times; only Haste at lower Uptie).
messages.S2「ピュニスィオン」: 自分の速度が対象より高ければコイン威力+2(低い同期化: **S2 — Punition**: +2 Coin Power if she is faster than the target (+1 at lower Uptie). Grants +2 Poise Count on use, 2 Poise with Coin Ⅰ, and inflicts 2 Bind next turn on Coin Ⅱ hit (1 at lower Uptie).
messages.S3「バレストラフォント」: 1コイン(8~22)。呼吸7以上なら最終威力+4(: **S3 — Balestra Fente**: 1 Coin (8–22). +4 Final Power with 7 or more Poise (+2 at lower Uptie). On hit, inflicts Declared Duel - Outis (+1 Clash Power in Clashes against the marked target, 1 Haste next turn on hitting attacks, up to 4 times per turn) and gives 2 Haste next turn to the 2 slowest allies (1 at lower Uptie).
messages.集中戦闘ではS1・S2で挑発値を取り、次のターンに集まった攻撃を「ルトレット」で: In Focused Encounters, take Aggro with S1 and S2, then evade the gathered attacks all together with Retraite the next turn. The more she outspeeds them, the stronger the Evade, and each successful Evade grants Haste and pushes back her Stagger Threshold through Redirect, so the more she keeps evading, the easier it is to maintain Speed and durability. S2 is her main attack, and S3 is for dealing with high-rolling enemy skills or applying Declared Duel to a single boss. Evade is unreliable at low SP, so securing SP is a challenge. Her contribution to damage is small.
